description: Each integer class has exactly one representation as (n,0), or as (0,n) with n positive, recording its sign and magnitude.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integer_normal_form (x : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.Integer) :
  ∃! p,
    (p.2 = true → 0 < p.1) ∧
      x =
        if p.2 = true then Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerClass 0 p.1
        else Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerClass p.1 0
